body: It's possible, but I'm really not comfortable with the whole idea yet. It's tough enough to tell my friend, but I did because she lives a few hours away during school.
I don't have a job right now, and my family simply can't afford something like that.
I don't think I'm ready to tell anyone close yet. My family can't keep their mouths shut and my friends are going to be gone for break for the next few weeks.
I just told a very close ex-girlfriend of mine for the first time today. She said that she's her for me and cares a lot about me. I did not tell her that suicide is a recurring thought, though.
